definition.title: Check if a buyer would trust your checkout
definition.description: Run before launch or after a signup walkthrough: get a fixed-rule PASS, FAIL or UNVERIFIED verdict on whether a careful buyer would trust your site and checkout, with ranked fixes handed to Improve site health or to you. Public GET requests only; it never signs in, submits forms, changes your site or claims CVE coverage.

human_review.reason: Produces externally visible trust claims and ranked fixes.
human_review.summary: Review the buyer-trust report before handing its fixes to Improve site health.

product_url.title: Product URL
product_url.description: The public HTTPS page a buyer arrives at, the same one the signup walkthrough used. Tin audits its origin.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Every depth runs the fixed gate checks. Focused adds the pricing or checkout entry page; standard adds contact, refund and terms pages; extensive adds up to three more money pages.

notes.title: Anything to check?
notes.description: Checkout quirks, known constraints, or areas a stranger would not know. Never credentials.

prerequisites.reason: The newest signup report for this host gives the checkout path, price line and walls, so the audit never re-walks signup.
The Feature map records plans, pricing and refund facts to compare with what the site tells a buyer.
The Code map shows whether the site's repository can take a fix, which decides hand-off to Improve site health.
The onboarding plan states the offer, audience and pricing the founder described.
